hero.title: About BMAD Methodology
hero.description: Breakthrough Method for Agile Development - A comprehensive approach to AEM project delivery

text.text:
What is BMAD?

BMAD (Breakthrough Method for Agile Development) is a structured methodology designed specifically for AEM projects. It combines best practices from agile development with AEM-specific patterns to deliver high-quality digital experiences.

Key Phases

  • Project Initialization
  • Business Discovery
  • Model Definition
  • Architecture Design
  • Development Sprint
  • Testing and Deployment
  • Operations
